title: chaos-resilient-kernel-sampler-and-prefill-decode-metrics-pipeline
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: build a low-overhead, robust metrics pipeline that produces statistically meaningful per-kernel and per-request telemetry for prefill and decode phases without flooding traces or adding tail-latency risk. This ticket implements a stratified kernel sampler, an NVTX "envelope" aggregator, and a span-correlation layer that maps GPU exec events back to request-level traces across scheduling boundaries. The pipeline must be resilient to noisy workloads ("chaos"), safe to enable in production for internal dogfood, and provide clear dashboards and alerting to detect regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Stratified sampler implemented: deterministic sampling buckets by model, sequence-length, and route so coverage of rare long-seq requests is guaranteed
NVTX envelope aggregator produces per-kernel aggregates (count, mean/std latency, memory-stalls, warps-active) and a compact binary summary for trace storage
Span correlation implemented: map GPU exec_id to Linear request_id and attach to trace spans in the tracer backend
End-to-end benchmarking shows <4% p95 added latency on a 50% traced traffic and <8% CPU overhead on control-plane sidecars
Dashboards in Grafana with taggable breakdowns (model, kernel, route, seq_len_bucket) and a playbook for investigating regressions
comments: 2025-02-14 - Aisha Patel: Initial spike completed. Prototype sampler using modular hashing works and reproduces stratified distributions on synthetic corpora. Observed ~1.7% overhead on control-plane with 20% sampling rate.
2025-02-19 - Connor Liu: Implemented NVTX envelope collector. Collector emits compact histogram blobs every 5s. Need to validate memory safety under high concurrency. Pushed PR #4321 for review.
2025-02-21 - Marisol Ortega (SRE): Reviewed PR #4321. Concern: current flush interval can accumulate ~40MB/s on busy nodes. Suggest backpressure + adaptive flush window tied to util and queue length.
2025-02-24 - Connor Liu: Added adaptive flush window and lock-free ring buffer to NVTX collector. Benchmarks show burst amortization reduces steady-state IO by 6x. Updated PR #4321 with perf numbers.

2025-02-26 - Rodrigo Mendes (Infra): Noted cross-host correlation requires synchronized exec_id mapping. Proposed small deterministic prefix in exec_id that includes host-epoch and worker-id. Will file infra change request.

2025-03-01 - QA (Priya Sharma): End-to-end test harness validated mapping accuracy on mixed workloads (small chat + long context). Two edge cases found: (1) preempted kernels without exec_id and (2) streams reused across unrelated requests. Added unit tests and fallback path that tags spans as 'exec_id_missing'.

2025-03-03 - Connor Liu: Merged sampler stratification PR (#4370). Rollout plan: enable for 10% of internal traffic next week, with auto-disable if tail-latency delta > 2x baseline. Next: dashboard widgets and alert rules.
